en.title: The Fed Enters Its Blackout Period This Weekend With a December Rate Hike 100% Priced In
en.desc: Bond traders dumped long Treasuries on the last day before Fed officials go silent, and a hike is already baked in. The real danger for TLT holders may be what the Fed reveals on December 9, so is this fund worth owning?

en.title: Ed Yardeni Wants Double the Fed Rate Hike the Market Expects
en.desc: Futures say the Fed will barely lift a finger in December, but one veteran strategist argues a bolder move could actually mean fewer hikes later. Wednesday's inflation data may decide whether his contrarian call looks reckless or prescient.

en.title: Bessent Warns the Fed Could Be Making a “Policy Mistake” if It Over-Tightens
en.desc: Three Treasury warnings in ten days, and the Fed still hasn't blinked. While stocks swing wildly, long bonds barely budge, and that gap reveals what investors truly expect before the December 9 decision.

en.title: Hedge the Dollar and Treasuries Barely Beat Bunds
en.desc: Today's big story: Nvidia Added $954 Billion In A Day. Is Jensen Huang Too Big To Fire.

en.title: Bill Ackman Says the Fed Is “About to Make Another Mistake” on Dec. 9
en.desc: Bill Ackman wants the Fed to abandon its 2% inflation goal before a rate decision that markets already expect. His case rests on one startling borrowing cost, and the Fed chair has already shut the door on his idea.

en.title: The New York Fed’s John Williams Won’t Rule Out Back-to-Back Rate Hikes
en.desc: Williams gave a calm speech, then said something sharper to reporters. One condition could push the Fed toward another hike right after December, and it decides which Treasury ETFs bruise and which ones recover.

en.title: How Much Do You Really Need Invested to Replace a $195,000 Salary With Dividends?
en.desc: Quitting a $195,000 job sounds simple until the yield you choose swings the price tag by millions. One high-paying holding already slashed its dividend, and the lowest-yielding stock in the mix may end up paying you the most.

en.title: SPY And Gold Fell Together. Did Bonds Save 60/40?
en.desc: Update, Nov 23: In Monday morning trading, SPY rose about 5% and the Nasdaq 100 fund (QQQ) about 7%, after Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. This article covers last week's fall, with figures at Friday's close.

en.title: The Fed’s Biggest Dove Sees No Clear Path Back to 2% Inflation
en.desc: When even a policymaker known for patience starts sounding alarmed, bond buyers lose a key ally. Goolsbee's warning raises a harder question for anyone holding long Treasuries: what happens if the Fed's last dove stops defending them?

en.title: Bond ETFs Haven’t Been This Rewarding in Years, So Why Is Wall Street Dumping Them?
en.desc: Investors are fleeing bond funds just as new bonds pay the most in years. One yield level will decide whether the exodus was smart or a costly mistake for anyone holding the safe 40% of a portfolio.

en.title: A Monthly Check at 3 Levels of Risk: VTEB, TLT and EMB, Ranked
en.desc: A retiree's monthly bond fund check can stay steady while the share price behind it quietly collapses. Ranking three popular payers on both risks produces two lists that point in opposite directions, and one fund flips from safe to scary.

en.title: Some Fed Officials Wanted to Hike in October. A Half-Point Hike Is on the Table.
en.desc: Fed minutes revealed a hawkish bloc bigger than the October vote let on, and Governor Waller says the central bank may need to shock people. Long bond holders now face a fork where one path rescues them and the other keeps squeezing.

en.title: AGG Lost Money Over 5 Years. Is 60/40 Broken?
en.desc: Today's big story: Could Anthropic Stock Fall 25.

en.title: Treasuries rally for a third day as stocks slip and oil falls
en.desc: Investing.com -- Treasuries rose for a third day as stocks slipped and oil fell. Bloomberg says traders also see much of the Fed’s expected tightening as priced in. All quotes are as of 11:16 AM EST on Nov 18 unless noted.

en.title: Two More Days Above 5% and Treasury Yields Tie 2007’s Run
en.desc: The 10-year yield has spent four straight sessions above a line it rarely crosses, and a bond auction plus Fed minutes arrive within hours. Whether the streak survives could decide what happens next for long-bond holders.
